description:

We're strong at landing new customers. Now we need to get excellent at growing them.

The DOW SkillBridge program is an opportunity for service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through specific industry training, apprenticeships, or internships during the last 180 days of service (or as DOW determines). For more than 25 years, Corcept has been singularly focused on the science of cortisol, a powerful hormone that when unregulated, can play a role in a broad range of diseases.

Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. With advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and liver disease, Corcept is unlocking the power of cortisol modulation to help address some of the most devastating diseases patients face today. 

Corcept is headquartered in Redwood City, California. To learn more, visit www.corcept.com .

Corcept is seeking a Senior Manager/Associate Director, Quality Operations to provide strategic and operational Quality leadership across commercial and clinical pharmaceutical manufacturing, testing, validation, disposition, and supply activities. This individual will serve as a senior Quality representative for CMC programs and external manufacturing and testing partners, helping ensure product quality, regulatory compliance, patient safety, and timely execution of Quality Operations deliverables in accordance with global cGMP requirements.

This is a hybrid role that typically requires on-site presence three days per week.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as a Quality Operations lead for complex CMC, commercial, and clinical supply programs by providing strategic quality direction, risk-based decision-making, and timely issue escalation

• Provide quality oversight of contract manufacturing organizations, contract testing laboratories, suppliers, and other external partners to ensure compliance with approved procedures, regulatory expectations, and quality agreements

• Review and approve GMP documentation, including batch records, analytical data, investigations, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, validation documentation, and product disposition records

• Lead or oversee quality investigations related to manufacturing, testing, packaging, labeling, storage, distribution, and product release activities, ensuring timely root cause analysis and effective corrective and preventive actions

• Review and approve validation protocols and reports, including process validation, analytical method validation, cleaning validation, packaging validation, and shipping lane qualification, as applicable

• Lead or support audits of suppliers, CLOs, CMOs, and service providers, including audit planning, execution, reporting, response evaluation, and follow-up of corrective actions

• Develop, monitor, and communicate Quality metrics and trend reports to identify compliance risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for continuous improvement

• Partner cross-functionally with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Clinical Operations, and Commercial teams to support submissions, inspections, product launches, and lifecycle management activities

• Mentor and guide Quality Operations staff and cross-functional team members, as applicable, to strengthen technical capability, inspection readiness, and operational excellence

Preferred Skills, Qualifications and Technical Proficiencies:

• An understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, analytical testing, validation, quality systems, and global cGMP expectations for commercial and clinical products

• Demonstrated ability to apply sound quality judgment, assess compliance risk, and make recommendations that support regulatory compliance, patient safety, product quality, and business continuity

• Experience with batch record review, product disposition, deviation management, CAPA, change control, validation, supplier quality, and quality agreement oversight

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and manage complex quality issues with internal departments and external partners

• Experience leading or supporting regulatory inspection

Great buildings don’t become great by accident. They’re shaped by thousands of thoughtful interactions that make people feel welcomed, connected, and excited to come back.

As a Community Manager, you’re responsible for bringing that experience to life every day. You own the programming, communications, and hospitality strategy for your office building: creating moments that strengthen community, deepen tenant engagement, and elevate the workplace experience.

This role blends creativity with operational excellence. You’ll curate events and partnerships, manage communications across multiple channels, oversee budgets and logistics, and ensure every detail, from a welcome email to a lobby activation, reflects the quality of the building and the brand.

Just as importantly, you’ll build relationships. You’ll know your tenants, understand what matters to them, and use those insights to shape experiences that feel personal, relevant, and worth showing up for.

• Event attendance is strong and growing. Tenants come because they actually want to, not out of obligation.

• Variety energizes you. One day you're building a vendor database, the next you're hosting a wellness activation, the next you're writing newsletter copy. You don't just tolerate the range - you enjoy it.

- Establish isolation and access controls across the kernel, applications, system services, and AI workloads.

- Define guardrails for how AI applications and agents access information, use sensors and tools, retain context, and act on a user’s behalf.

- Lead threat modeling and architecture reviews across the platform, translating emerging threats into practical, enforceable requirements.

- Prototype solutions, review security-critical systems code, and guide engineering teams through complex technical and product tradeoffs.

- Deep experience designing or securing operating systems, kernels, embedded platforms, hypervisors, or other privileged systems software.

title: B2B Social Media & Events Manager
description:
ClickTime is a recognized leader in time management software, serving thousands of enterprises, nonprofits, and governments worldwide. From bootstrapped beginnings to sustained profitability - all without venture capital funding - ClickTime has tracked over $210 billion worth of employee time, helping customers improve workforce efficiency, profitability, and resource planning. While headquartered in San Francisco, ClickTime 's team works remotely across the United States.
About the Role

ClickTime helps finance and operations leaders turn messy time data into accurate labor costs for budgeting, forecasting, and compliance. The product works. Customers stay. The next stage of growth is getting in front of the finance and operations professionals who need us but don't yet know we exist - controllers, project managers, and the finance and ops leaders they work alongside.

As our Social Media and Events Manager, you'll own ClickTime 's social strategy and partner on event strategy, building visibility and credibility across the full buying circle. You'll produce the content that makes both programs work, and show up as a recognizable, credible face of the brand.

This is a creator role. Successful candidates are comfortable on camera, enjoy learning complex topics, and publish consistently without needing a lot of hand-holding.

Responsibilities

• Own social strategy and execution: set the approach, build a publishing cadence, and grow an engaged following across the finance and ops buying circle

• Shape event strategy: help pick the right conferences, then conduct live coverage, interviews, and recap content onsite

• Produce content that fuels both programs: short-form video, carousels, infographics, event recaps, product explainers

• Use AI to scale production without sacrificing quality

• Participate credibly in finance and ops communities (e.g. LinkedIn, relevant subreddits, industry forums)

Qualifications

• 3+ years in B2B social media, content marketing, or a creator role for a professional audience

• Track record growing a LinkedIn or B2B social channel with real engagement

• Experience running event content - live coverage, recaps, conference representation

• Comfortable on camera and representing a company publicly, at events and online

• Real AI tool use in your content workflow, with the judgment to know when output isn't good enough

• Able to earn trust across a finance/ops audience; bonus points if you've created for finance, accounting, FP&A, or enterprise SaaS audiences

• Open to travel for events, roughly 2-6 times a year as the program grows

title: Mechanical Commissioning Engineer
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Mechanical Commissioning Engineer to execute the buildout, startup, and handover of mechanical systems for SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. This is a hands-on role where you will commission, test, troubleshoot, and turn over critical cooling, air handling, and fluid distribution systems that support next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with construction, engineering, operations, EPC contractors, and OEM vendors to deliver safe, reliable, and high-quality mechanical systems. This is a full-time, onsite role with travel to SpaceXAI data center construction sites across the United States.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute all mechanical commissioning activities for HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAC/CRAH units, pumps, heat exchangers, piping systems, hydronic loops, and associated controls in hyperscale data center environments.

• Execute functional performance testing, airflow/water flow verification, system balancing, integrated system testing, and system turnover to operations.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical, controls, and process issues during pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup phases.

• Develop and review detailed commissioning test procedures, scripts, checklists, and documentation in alignment with project specifications, industry standards, and SpaceXAI requirements.

• Coordinate with EPC contractors, OEM vendors, design engineers, and SpaceXAI stakeholders for system energization, startup sequences, and integrated system validation.

• Champion safety by enforcing strict adherence to LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols; participate in daily safety briefings and job hazard analyses.

• Maintain comprehensive as-built documentation, test records, issue logs, and final commissioning reports.

• Support and deliver training programs for operations and maintenance teams on commissioned systems.

• Support commissioning schedules and punch-list resolution to meet aggressive project timelines.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in STEM degree or trade school certification in Mechanical Engineering Technology, HVAC, or a related field

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Expertise in mechanical cooling and air-handling systems, including chillers, cooling towers, CRAC/CRAH units, precision air handling, chilled water plants, and/or high-density liquid cooling.

• Working knowledge of commissioning test equipment (manometers, anemometers, ultrasonic flow meters, pressure/temperature calibrators, power analyzers, etc.), or demonstrated aptitude to learn it in the field.

• Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (ASHRAE, SMACNA, NFPA, ASME, IMC, LEED, Uptime Institute).

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft 

Doctolib sucht Dich ab Oktober 2026 als Praktikant:in im Bereich Human Resources für unseren Standort in Berlin .

Wir bei Doctolib wollen das Gesundheitswesen digitalisieren und sowohl den Arbeitsalltag von Gesundheitsfachkräften vereinfachen, als auch den Zugang zu Gesundheitsleistungen für Patient:innen vereinfachen. Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns bei dieser Mission, indem Du dazu beiträgst, einen reibungslosen Ablauf in unserer HR-Abteilung sicherzustellen.  

Deine Aufgaben

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

• Du übernimmst die Erstellung von Verträgen und anderen Personaldokumenten sowie das administrative Onboarding unserer neuen Mitarbeitenden.

• Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden und bearbeitest ihre Anfragen in unserem Ticketsystem.

• Du übernimmst gewissenhaft das Abwesenheits- und Datenmanagement unserer Mitarbeitenden in unserem HR-Informationssystem Workday.

• Du pflegst unsere Wissensdatenbank und erstellst Präsentationen.

• Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du uns bei Recherchen und Reporting-Aufgaben und bringst Dich in globale HR-Projekte ein.

Während Deiner Tätigkeit wirst Du:

• Einen tieferen Einblick in die täglichen HR Prozesse eines international agierenden Unternehmens erlangen

• Deine Kenntnisse im Bereich Arbeitsrecht, Vertrags- und Dokumentenverwaltung sowie Personaladministration ausbauen

• Dich im Bereich People Projektmanagement weiterentwickeln

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich dazu, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres HR Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Du begeisterst dich für das Thema HR, hast Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen und Lust, praktische Erfahrungen in den oben genannten Tätigkeiten zu sammeln

• Du arbeitest strukturiert und gewissenhaft und verfügst über eine sehr gute Selbstorganisation 

• Du hast ein Auge fürs Detail, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Du verfügst über fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und hast Freude an der Arbeit in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Word und Excel und hast Lust, neue Tools und KI-gestützte Technologien kennenzulernen

Was wir Dir bieten

• Ein strukturiertes und individuelles Onboarding im Rahmen unserer Doctolib Academy sowie ein breites Angebot interner Trainingsprogramme

• Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder die Übernahme Deines Semestertickets

• Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell , das hybrides und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht

title: Director, Content Marketing & Social Media
description:
See yourself at Dataminr

Dataminr is looking for a strategic B2B marketeer to become our Director of Content Marketing and Social Media, reporting to the VP of Brand and Communications. You'll spearhead shaping a high-impact content and social strategy that builds brand awareness, thought leadership, and demand - owning the content roadmap and social execution that brings our storytelling to life.

We're looking for a self-starter who can set the vision while executing fast, someone who knows how to craft content for every stage of the buyer's journey, get it in front of the right audiences, and prove its impact through data. You'll turn complex topics in corporate security, cybersecurity, and public sector into content that resonates. This is a rare chance to shape Dataminr 's voice, elevate our AI and security leadership, and build a content engine that fuels real growth. AI Innovation at Dataminr
Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.
Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.
Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here
Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.
The Opportunity

• Own end-to-end content strategy and the content roadmap, positioning Dataminr as a leader in real-time information and aligning with marketing, sales, and product priorities to deliver against time-bound goals.

• Develop and edit high-quality content - blogs, whitepapers, reports, case studies, videos - with SMEs, implementing content standards, templates, and consistent messaging across all materials.

• Develop and execute a social media strategy that drives brand building, audience growth, conversions, and awareness, including campaigns for top-of-funnel brand awareness and middle-of-funnel demand generation, and strategies tailored to regional needs (primarily EMEA).

• Amplify employer brand and executive presence through content and social activity around corporate initiatives, thought leaders, and culture, partnering with PR, social, and digital teams to extend reach across earned, owned, and paid channels.

• Develop and monitor key performance metrics (organic traffic, SEO, engagement, conversions, leads), measuring and optimizing content and social performance.

• Conduct interviews with internal and external stakeholders - customers, thought leaders - to fuel content ideation, serving as an evangelist for Dataminr 's brand and message through thought leadership.

• Develop and maintain AI-powered workflows, tools, and best practices for the content team - establishing standards that ensure consistency, brand voice alignment, and compliance (e.g., Gartner citation rules) across all AI-assisted output.

• Leverage AI to accelerate content ideation, drafting, and production across formats, enabling the team to scale output and turnaround time without sacrificing editorial quality or strategic rigor.

What you bring
At Dataminr , we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

• BS/MS degree in Marketing or related field (journalism experience a plus), with leadership experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 8+ years of demonstrable experience across content strategy, asset development, and demand generation

description:
Job Description:
Lead Benefits Analyst
Location: Remote
Reports To: Director, Total Rewards
Position Summary
The Lead Benefits Analyst plays a critical role within J.D. Power 's Total Rewards team, leading the administration, delivery, and continuous improvement of employee benefits and leave programs across the organization. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for U.S. benefits and leave administration while providing support and guidance for Canadian and global benefits programs.
The Lead Benefits Analyst partners closely with People & Culture, Payroll, HRIS, Finance, external vendors, and employees to ensure benefits programs are administered efficiently, remain compliant with applicable regulations, and provide an exceptional employee experience. The position requires strong expertise in Workday Benefits and Absence Management, vendor management, employee communications, and leave administration.
Key Responsibilities
Benefits Administration

• Lead the day-to-day administration of U.S. health and welfare benefit programs, including self-insured medical, dental, vision, life, disability, voluntary benefits, wellness, and retirement plans.

• Support Canadian benefits administration and develop knowledge of global benefit programs to assist with international benefits initiatives.

• Ensure accurate employee eligibility, enrollment, life event processing, and dependent administration within Workday.

• Coordinate and execute annual open enrollment activities, including system testing, communications, employee education, and post-enrollment audits.

• Conduct periodic benefits audits and reconciliations to maintain data integrity between Workday, payroll, and carrier systems.

• Support implementation and administration of new benefit programs and plan enhancements.

Leave of Absence Administration

• Serve as the subject matter for all employee leaves of absence and key liaison with our leave administration partner

• Coordinate leaves as needed with our third party leave administrator including FMLA, ADA accommodations, state and local paid leave programs, disability leaves, military leave, parental leave, and personal leaves of absence.

• Partner with employees, managers, payroll, and third-party administrators to ensure leave cases are managed accurately and compassionately.

• Monitor return-to-work processes and ensure appropriate documentation and compliance requirements are satisfied.

• Stay informed regarding federal, state, provincial, and local leave regulations and proactively implement required process changes.

Workday Benefits & HR Systems

• Act as the functional subject matter expert for Workday Benefits and Absence Management.

• Configure, test, and maintain Workday benefit and leave processes, events, eligibility rules, and workflows including open enrollment.

• Support benefit integrations, carrier file feeds, and vendor interfaces.

• Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics related to benefits participation, leave activity, and compliance metrics.

• Partner with HRIS resources to identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities.

Vendor Management

• Manage relationships with benefits carriers, brokers, consultants, third-party administrators, and leave management vendors.

• Conduct regular vendor reviews to evaluate service levels, compliance, performance, and employee experience.

• Coordinate issue resolution and escalations to ensure timely and effective outcomes.

• Support benefits renewals, plan implementations, and vendor contract reviews.

Employee Support & Communication

• Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers regarding benefits, leave programs, and Workday self-service functionality.

• Respond to complex employee inquiries and escalations with professionalism and empathy.

• Develop employee communications, educational resources, and manager guides related to benefits and leave programs.

As a consecutive interpreter, you will bridge language gaps, ensuring clarity and understanding in various over-the-phone situations.

• Provide consecutive interpretation services during phone calls, meetings, conferences, interviews, and more.

• Respect HIPAA and comply with 360 SL protocol, policies, and industry best practices as required by Reviver Global clients.

Requirements:

• 1+ years of experience or 3000 hours of active interpretation.

• Proficiency in at least two languages (source and target languages).

• Completion of Mock Call assessment with passing score.

• Updated Resume that shows relevant interpretation experience.

• Criminal background check in English.
